Please contact the library to borrow a print copy of the book. eBook and downloadable audiobook are available through Libby . Summary provided by the publisher: The electrifying true story of a young couple shipwrecked at sea: a mind-blowing tale of obsession, survival, and partnership stretched to its limits. Maurice and Maralyn make an odd couple. He's a loner, awkward and obsessive; she's charismatic and ambitious. But they share a horror of wasting their lives.
